supersedes.why_superseded: The v1 verdict is upheld but its reasoning was unsound. v1 drew its left-to-right evidence from a capture that is temporally invalid, and it declared no mechanical repair justified when a real mechanical production defect was present. The blocking finding is relocated to the right-to-left rehearsal, whose entry transition was captured with correct frame-to-tick alignment.

prospective_expected_target_algorithm.rule: entry = first index whose next 19 world-x samples all lie inside the fixed interval [HIDDEN_LEFT, HIDDEN_RIGHT]; guard check requires entry minus the first GEOMETRIC_ENTRY crossing to be at most ENTRY_GUARD[direction]
prospective_expected_target_algorithm.consumed_as: expected_stable_hidden_onset_frame, frozen into all 25 scientific spec hashes

observed_target_algorithm.rule: onset = first index beginning a 19-frame run of OCCLUDED_AGREEMENT; transition_start walks back over consecutive VISIBILITY_DISAGREEMENT or INVALID_VISIBILITY; refuse when onset minus transition_start exceeds ENTRY_GUARD[direction]

source_level_algorithm_comparison.kind_compatibility: Both quantities measure the same kind of thing, a pre-stable-hidden disagreement transition width, so the comparison is well posed. The two are not related by any frame-index offset.
deterministic_divergence_points_examined: startspec command frame versus first episode frame
server tick versus client tick offset
source_level_algorithm_comparison.divergence_point_confirmed: render frame to server tick temporal validity, which index equality alone does not establish

verified_correct.server_geometric_detector: geometric_visible flips exactly at the frozen GEOMETRIC_ENTRY constants and is direction-consistent and symmetric about camera world x 0.5: occluded span measured [-4.8203, 5.9122] left-to-right and [-4.8729, 5.8290] right-to-left
verified_correct.stream_index_join: server_epoch_nanos identical across server_state and client_tick for 260/260 rows in both rehearsals; render_frame_idx equals row index; streams strictly monotonic
verified_correct.guard_binding: ENTRY_GUARD/EXIT_GUARD are bound to direction correctly in both the prospective and observed implementations

left_to_right.observed_artifact: frames 0-9 blank sky before world load; frames 10-18 a single frozen partially-loaded render in which the occluder chunk is absent and the target is spuriously detected inside the occluder footprint

right_to_left.measurement_trust_basis: Every frame in the entry transition window was captured strictly inside its own tick. The 73 stale frames all occur at index 186 or later, in the post-exit tail, and do not touch the entry measurement.
right_to_left.refusal: observed entry transition exceeds frozen guard

blocking_finding.statement: On a capture with correct frame-to-tick alignment, the real production geometry produces a right-to-left entry transition of 10 frames against a frozen entry guard of 8. The refusal is correct and cannot be removed by any mechanical repair.
blocking_finding.underlying_constant_error: The frozen prospective full-hidden boundary HIDDEN_RIGHT = 5.426536982279787 overstates the measured visual full-hidden boundary of approximately 4.957. The frozen model therefore predicts a right-to-left entry transition of about 5.5 frames where the production runtime produces 10.
blocking_finding.why_not_mechanically_repairable: Correcting HIDDEN_LEFT/HIDDEN_RIGHT, or widening ENTRY_GUARD[RIGHT_TO_LEFT], changes values that are hash-bound into entry_guard_frames, expected_stable_hidden_onset_frame, expected_stable_hidden_exit_frame, and expected_tau_1_to_19_world_x in every frozen spec body, and therefore changes all 25 spec hashes and the frozen trajectory manifest SHA256.
blocking_finding.guard_provenance_note: g_entry for RIGHT_TO_LEFT was never measured. s0_guard_semantics_receipt.json derives it as a time reversal of the left-to-right A0 measurement, and geometry_camera_authority.json records BIDIRECTIONAL_GEOMETRY_SUPPORTED = UNCLEAR with an explicit recommendation not to assume bidirectional symmetry.

full_end_to_end_rehearsal_gate: Q8 requires exact target eligibility reconciliation before the complete production path may run. That gate is not met.
